verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Resend offers a free starting tier (community mention 'pricing starts free') and full API/SMTP send capabilities, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of free-tier sending limits, domain-verification requirements, or confirmation that free-tier emails go to real end-users rather than a sandbox/demo mode. Missing for 10: explicit free-tier quota/restriction docs, confirmation that free plan supports sending to arbitrary real recipients (not just verified test addresses), and independent user reports validating real production use on the free plan.
